scope: New bounded experiments on the pinned PR370 E8 bit word. Novelty is checked against public PR descriptions and the PR368 campaign; worldwide priority is not asserted.

Suppress rank-six reads to merge the final E8 target climb
Suppress rank-five reads while keeping rank-four and rank-six deliveries
Deliver every E8 side sum at its target cap
Replace greedy E8 carrier chains by exact minimum path covers
Weight the E8 carrier path cover by the entropy derivative of rank cost
Weight the E8 carrier path cover by the current saving exponent
Assign original E8 sources to the deepest eligible carrier chain
Assign original E8 sources to the cheapest complete rank path
Defer pure-helper E8 rules until after copied-total scatter
Cut the E8 hierarchy at rank three and rebuild high nodes after scatter
Cut the E8 hierarchy at rank four and rebuild high nodes after scatter
Cut the E8 hierarchy at rank five and rebuild high nodes after scatter
Reassociate E8 XOR nodes into balanced support trees
Reassociate E8 XOR nodes by minimum rational frame rank
Reuse the largest existing E8 partial sum inside each target support
Lower every E8 gate to the join of actual predecessor frames
Raise every E8 gate to the root-spanned meet of successor frames
Alternate legal extremal E8 gate frames under concave rank-cost scoring
Retime equal-frame E8 gate components together to escape single-gate traps
Move commuting E8 additions toward each register's next use
Move commuting E8 additions toward each register's preceding use
